summary: feat(settings): record passkey alert and banner views in Glean
description:
Because:
- Glean had no event for a shown Settings alert or sign-in banner.
- Passkey alerts and links had no Glean IDs.

This commit:
- Adds the events alert_bar.view and banner.view.
- Makes AlertBar and Banner record a view through an opt-in gleanId.
- Tags the AlertBar close button from the gleanId.
- Adds Glean IDs to passkey alerts, Learn more links and sign-in banners.
- Uses account_pref_passkey_create_unsupported for the unsupported row.
- Polls for both click IDs in the unsupported passkey functional test.

Closes FXA-13972
